items.name: Gjetertaske
items.observations: The full-plant watercolor illustrates a slender upright branching stem with terminal clusters of small four-petaled white flowers and abundant distinctly flattened heart- to triangle-shaped green silicles along elongated pedicels. At the base it shows a rosette of deeply irregularly lobed leaves and a fine taproot. Sparse narrow stem leaves appear above the basal rosette. These botanical recognition characters are consistent with NIBIO and Artsdatabanken.
items.limitations: Some seed pods are visually enlarged and overly symmetrical or rounded, while real Capsella bursa-pastoris pods are flattened obtriangular and have a notched broad tip. Basal foliage can vary from entire to deeply lobed; the drawing emphasizes the lobed morphology. Pod sizes, branching habit, floral spacing and root architecture are reconstructed rather than specimen-accurate. The licensed species photograph remains available to corroborate field identification.
items.technicalVerification: Original PNG 1024x1536 RGBA with nonuniform alpha. Removed low-opacity ambient haze (alpha cutoff 14) and converted to transparent VP8X WebP at quality 92. Previewed with dark and white backgrounds. Final 216000 bytes SHA256 and Git blob SHA calculated locally; GitHub create_blob independently returned identical Git SHA.
